text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our first three years in the Twinkle Series are officially over, and Seeking the Pearl now shines as brilliantly as the gem she's named after.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Trainer, this is the year I finally go abroad! And the race I have my sights set on…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Is none other than the Prix Maurice de Gheest! Namely, the destined race you found for me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's been a year, but now it's time to do this for real! The world had best be ready for me, because I'm even faster than I was last year!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Incredible! Seeking the Pearl wins by a landslide! After a powerful start, she manages to maintain her lead throughout!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: All the other racers were caught off guard by her relentless speed, and the pace was thrown completely off!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! That went exactly as Trainer planned! A fine result, if I do say so myself. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (But… this victory is a lot less impactful than it could've been. After all, I'm only the second Tracen racer to win a European G1, not the first…)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (Still… this was the choice I made.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl heads back to Japan without much fanfare. Some time later…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What? The "Top 100 Umamusume in History"?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes. Apparently, they're going to hold a fan poll to select 100 Umamusume to feature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl's roommate, Kawakami Princess, tells us about what went on at Tracen Academy while we were abroad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: According to her, there is going to be a massive fan poll involving all Umamusume, past and present.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A whole 100 Umamusume… That may seem like a lot, but it'll probably be really hard to be selected as part of that group.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There are as many great Umamusume in all of history as there are stars in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Even if I'm a pearl, compared to so many brilliant stars, well…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text: That's all for the "Top 100 Umamusume in History." Congratulations to all of the nominees!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: …Seeking the Pearl didn't make the list. I really thought she had a chance.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she even won a G1 race abroad, but I guess we shouldn't be too surprised. I mean…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Jolt!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… What was that just now?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Was that some kind of prophetic dream? Well… that's probably what'll end up happening anyway.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (Rather than being the first to win an international race, I chose to compete with Taiki, all for the sake of showing off the possibilities I possess.)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (That's right. I chose to live on in memories, not records.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's the day they're announcing the final picks for the "Top 100 Umamusume in History."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, let us begin. It is a tremendous honor for any currently active Umamusume to be chosen as one of these 100 representatives.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As such, please cheer and celebrate earnestly for each of them as they are announced.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After Symboli Rudolf's speech, she goes on to list name after name until…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, it appears a currently active Umamusume has been chosen for this honor. I present to you…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What?! Really?! Howdy-do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The massive cheers that envelope Taiki Shuttle are even louder than the ones that celebrated her G1 victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And she deserves it. Everyone knows how incredible it is to be voted by fans into a permanent hall of fame like this.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm not surprised in the least. Taiki's the first Tracen Umamusume to win a European G1, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (Congratulations, Taiki… You fit right among the greats.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The ceremony continues, and legendary Umamusume are named one after another…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Before I announce the next name, there's something I'd like to say to all of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This celebration of the Top 100 Umamusume in History isn't just about placements and accomplishments. It's about how much emotion these Umamusume inspired in their fans as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This following Umamusume gave her fans something more than glory…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And perhaps this award is proof of just how avidly her fans followed her journey.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, enough preamble. Let me introduce to you our next Umamusume on the list…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait… what?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What's… going on? I… I wasn't even the first racer to win a European G1…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I was happy just being second to Taiki, but this…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Pearl! You really did it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Taiki…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd be picked! I… I…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I totally woulda voted for you if I were a fan!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Taiki…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Contrary to her usual talkative self, Seeking the Pearl falls into pensive silence. Earning this spot proves that Pearl had fans from all over the world watching her career with great interest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They watched as she continued to challenge herself, all for the sake of imparting courage to everyone in the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to cry, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I am a pearl who's more precious, beautiful, and confident than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So I won't let myself cry! I absolutely won't!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Now go on and awe us with your acceptance speech!
Yeah! Now go on and awe us with your acceptance speech!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl doesn't need any encouragement or consolation. She just needs me to back her up when she toots her own horn.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Seeking the Pearl here! Geez, the fans out there sure have weird taste!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I settled for being the second Tracen racer to win a European G1…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But I still appreciate your vote and recognition, everyone! No matter how people see me, there's one thing I will never allow.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I don't care if you forget about me, but don't you ever, ever forget what I stand for.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Every single person in this world has limitless possibilities lying in their futures! You, me—everyone!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So follow my lead! Let's all keep searching for our potential together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her prestigious nomination, Seeking the Pearl now goes down in history in both race records and people's memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her story is but one in a world of limitless possibilities. After all, for Seeking the Pearl, this world is her oyster.
